journey.question: What happens when a shopper asks for a refund?
journey.title: Refunds
journey.summary: A shopper asks for money back on a paid order. The API marks the order and queues a job, and the worker asks the payment provider to refund it.

nodes.label: Shop API
nodes.summary: The HTTP API that holds orders and the waiting jobs.

nodes.label: Worker
nodes.summary: The process that takes jobs from the API and talks to the provider.

nodes.label: Payment provider
nodes.summary: The third-party service that holds the charge and makes refunds.

questions.text: What happens to an order in refund_pending if the API restarts before the worker takes its refund job?
After a failed refund, what happens when the customer asks again for a different amount, given the idempotency key?
Why does startRefund check the status inside its UPDATE instead of relying on the status read in refundOrder?
